relationships.subject: Imatinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Administration of the PDGFR inhibitor imatinib significantly alleviated LSS-induced macrophages activation and infiltration.

relationships.subject: Imatinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Imatinib also reduced LSS-induced chronic mechanical allodynia and inhibited the expression of inflammatory mediators including tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-α), interleukin beta (IL-1β), interleukin 6 (IL-6), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), and inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS).

relationships.subject: PDGFR
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that the PDGFR and Janus kinase 2/signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (JAK2/STAT3) signaling pathways were upregulated in infiltrated macrophages at 28 days in the LSS model.

key_findings: PDGFR and JAK2/STAT3 are upregulated in infiltrating macrophages in a rat lumbar spinal stenosis model.
Imatinib reduced macrophage infiltration, inflammatory mediators and allodynia.
